message.content: In the discussions, LiHua mentions several memorable moments from Messi's career. Specifically, LiHua expresses that his favorite moment is when Messi scored a header in the Champions League match against Manchester United in 2011. LiHua describes this goal as "so unexpected and showcased his versatility." This particular moment stands out due to its unexpected nature and Messi's ability to deliver a critical goal in a high-pressure situation.
